title: EVD-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for EEG-to-Image Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: EEG-to-image decoding recovers visual information from non-invasive brain recordings, providing a window into human perception. However, comparisons across systems are confounded by a variable that is rarely reported as such: which participants' data the system was allowed to use. The same Top-1 score on a 200-way gallery may come from a per-participant system, a pooled model over all participants, or a model that never saw the test participant---cases that differ by more than most architectural changes between the methods being compared. We present \bench, a benchmark on THINGS-EEG2 that standardizes the gallery and EEG input, matches training budgets across systems within each regime, and compares three participant-access regimes: within-subject, joint-subject, and strict leave-one-subject-out, with unlabeled target calibration reported separately. translated_title: EVD-Bench：一个用于脑电到图像解码的综合基准
translated_abstract: 脑电到图像解码能够从非侵入性脑电记录中恢复视觉信息，为了解人类感知提供了一扇窗口。然而，跨系统的比较受到一个很少被明确报告的变量的干扰：系统被允许使用哪些参与者的数据。同样在200类图像库上的Top-1分数，可能来自单一被试系统、所有被试汇总训练的模型，或从未见过测试被试的模型——这些情况之间的差异甚至超过被比较方法之间的大多数架构改动。我们提出了EVD-Bench，这是一个基于THINGS-EEG2数据集的基准，它标准化了图像库和脑电输入，在每种设置下匹配各系统的训练预算，并比较三种被试数据访问模式：被试内、联合被试和严格的留一被试外，其中无标签目标校准单独报告。所有三种设置均评估概念级别的零样本检索：200个测试概念是……
tldr: 提出了基于THINGS-EEG2的EVD-Bench基准，通过标准化图像库与脑电输入、匹配训练预算，并系统比较被试内、联合被试和留一被试外三种数据访问模式，解决了脑电到图像解码跨系统比较中因训练数据使用方式不同而导致的混淆问题。
